supersedes.reason: User wants a reduction from 920 hours. Reassessed selective savings in code generation and reuse; no uniform speedup factor.

basis: Selective reductions where AI-assisted repetitive implementation and reuse can plausibly shorten work, without removing acceptance or independent testing. Provisional, not measured team productivity.
